notes: Optimized Freepik Companion JPEG Generation: Companion preview JPEGs are now generated exclusively for the Freepik export workflow, eliminating unnecessary file creation for other platforms.
Custom Companion Image Size Control: Added a dedicated setting in Preferences allowing users to configure target dimensions and DPI requirements for companion JPEGs.
Improved 'Embed As' Flow: Enhanced directory handling and path resolution when exporting assets for specific individual marketplaces.
